about.desc: Yobi builds automation on top of AI web services by driving their web interfaces in a built-in browser window. By default it does not use the providers' official APIs and does not run a local model; with your own API key (BYOK) it calls that provider's API instead. Works with Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT and Perplexity, and runs from chat, global hotkeys, scheduled flows, or Telegram and LINE.

bot.chat.help:
How to use me:

• Send a message — the AI answers, going online, reading pages or using other tools when it needs to.
• You can also send a link or a YouTube link and ask the AI to summarize it or answer questions about it.
• To pick a model, start with its command, e.g. /gemini your question. The full list is below.
• If the AI needs to know more it asks, and your next reply carries on from there.
• In a group, tag me with your question: @Bot …

Commands: {{commands}}

Answers take a while: the AI runs on my owner’s computer, and I message you as soon as it finishes.
Send /help to see this again.

flow.skill.air_quality.desc: Get the air quality index (AQI) for a place
flow.skill.air_quality.disclosure: Open-Meteo values are modelled estimates and can differ from an official ground station by a few points. Taiwan uses the same AQI bands as the US, but its stricter PM2.5 standard can shift a reading that sits near a band boundary.
flow.skill.air_quality.location.hint: City or district. Taiwan places in Chinese or English (e.g. 高雄, 鳳山); elsewhere in English.
flow.skill.air_quality.moenv.hint: Registration is free. The key is encrypted on this device and is never written into the flow, so sharing or exporting a flow does not carry it.
flow.skill.air_quality.moenv.key.placeho: Paste the key; save it blank to clear
flow.skill.air_quality.source.auto.hint: A location in Taiwan reads the nearest Ministry of Environment station once a key is saved below; everywhere else uses Open-Meteo.
flow.skill.air_quality.source.taiwan.hin: Always reads the nearest Ministry of Environment station. With no key saved, or for a place more than 50 km from every station, it falls back to Open-Meteo.

flow.skill.almanac.lunar: The date is a lunar date

flow.skill.browser_open.show.hint: Open a visible window (e.g. to sign in manually the first time) instead of in the background.

flow.skill.http.desc: Call an API and capture the response
flow.skill.if.desc: Run a block only when a condition holds

flow.skill.js.hint: Previous step outputs are available as variables by their output key (e.g. {{outputKey}} is the variable outputKey). Runs in-process at the same trust level as a Shell Command step.

flow.skill.line_read.desc: Read your LINE chat history as text
flow.skill.line_read.error.starved: Not one LINE message fits the AI provider's input limit. Pick fewer chats, or a provider with a larger limit.
flow.skill.line_read.error.tooManyChats: "{{name}}" matches {{count}} LINE chats, more than the {{max}} one run can read. Type more of the name.

flow.skill.llm.desc: Send a prompt to an AI and get a reply

- **[Title]**: {{title}}

- **[URL]**: {{url}}

---

Skip pleasantries. Output directly in Markdown:

### 1. TL;DR

The core message of the video in one or two sentences.

### 2. Key Points

The main topics, arguments, and takeaways in a logical order (use bullets or a timeline if helpful).

### 3. Conclusions & Takeaways

The video's conclusion plus any actionable insights for the viewer.

---
